root_cause: The production brain_records taxonomy rejects SourceObservation/raw_source, BusinessInput/SourceTruth and ImpactAssessment/organism_impact emitted by V2. The connector handler additionally treated native Request.body ReadableStream as parsed JSON, silently discarding draft configuration. The connector function only registered /api/connectors/*, so the collection create/list endpoint returned a live HTML 404 while child routes returned authenticated JSON.
prevention_rule: Replay actual writer output against versioned Postgres constraints and test the active browser API with native Request objects, not only pre-parsed request doubles. Preserve RLS, ACL, immutable lineage, idempotency and provider activation proof. Register and test the exact collection route as well as wildcard child routes, retaining the separate readiness exclusion.

test_evidence.red: Original writer reproduced RAW_SOURCE_WRITE_FAILED/502; native connector adapter lost source.config.
test_evidence.green: 45 targeted checks passed; isolated PostgreSQL migration replay twice, actual writer four records per each of two fixture tenants, replay dedupe and invalid taxonomy rejection.
test_evidence.additional_live_finding: GET /api/connectors and trailing slash return HTML404; child route returns JSON401. Added exact collection route and preserved wildcard/readiness isolation; new regression failed before the fix and passed after.
test_evidence.broader_baseline_failure: The unchanged production-truth test expects createDeliveryPlan in production-release-readback.yml; this assertion fails on the current main workflow independently of this change. No gate was weakened.
